test_title: PYST 32 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:

They are building a new shopping mall.

options.text: A new shopping mall has been built by them.
A new shopping mall is being built by them.
A new shopping mall is built by them.
A new shopping mall was being built by them.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence "They are building a new shopping mall" is in the **Present Continuous Tense**.
 
• **Identify the Tense:** The active form uses *is/am/are + verb-ing*. When converting this to the passive voice, the structure changes to **is/am/are + being + V3 (past participle)**.
 
• **Identify the Subject and Object:** 
 
 
• **Subject:** They
 
• **Object:** A new shopping mall
 
 
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object **"A new shopping mall"** at the beginning. Since it is singular, use **"is being built."**
 
• Add the preposition **"by"** followed by the agent **"them"** (the objective case of 'they').

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A new shopping mall is being built by them."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"A new shopping mall has been built..." – Incorrect because it changes the tense to **Present Perfect**.
 
• **Option 3: **"A new shopping mall is built..." – Incorrect because it changes the tense to **Simple Present**.
 
• **Option 4: **"A new shopping mall was being built..." – Incorrect because it changes the tense to **Past Continuous**.
